policy: Nestle prints these places and no word of it carries them: its number is not the name's, so the resolution by number cannot reach them.
source: Essenthos, read off Nestle's words on the project owner's instruction of 2026-11-01 that a word of the originals printing a name carries it

rulings.why: 'εἰς Νέαν Πόλιν' (ACT 16:11): Nestle prints the town's name as two words, numbered as the common words new and city; the Textus Receptus prints it as one, G3496.
'εἰς Νέαν Πόλιν' (ACT 16:11): the second word of the town's name as Nestle prints it.
'ἀνήχθημεν ἐπὶ τὴν Ἆσσον' (ACT 20:13): the town; Nestle's word is numbered G788, the adverb nearer, where the town's number is G789.
'εἰς τὴν Ἆσσον' (ACT 20:14): the town, numbered as in the verse before.
